## Problem and change

Describe the user problem and resulting behavior. Link a relevant issue or
upstream reference when available.

## Validation

List checks actually run and any hardware/runtime versions used. Distinguish
automated tests, user-reported results, and checks still needed. Keep runtime
images and local configuration out of the source package.

## Compatibility and attribution

Mention path, command, configuration, or QEMU-argument changes and their migration.
Disclose material AI assistance and preserve upstream notices.
